read.thesis: Q4 organic growth 5.6% beat guidance, but 2026 organic CC guided 3-6% with a 1-point NEORIS client drag, utilisation down to 75.4% and lengthening AI-deal sales cycles.

utilisation.quote: Utilization was 75.4% compared to 76.2% in Q4 of last year and 76.5% in Q3 2025.

triggers.label: Utilisation 76.5% → 75.4% QoQ

triggers.label: Low-single-digit rate increases at clients
triggers.quote: a quite significant number of clients in both Europe and North America are giving us at least low single-digit rate increases

triggers.label: FY26 organic CC guide 3-6%
triggers.quote: the organic constant currency growth rate is expected to be in the range of 3% to 6%.

triggers.label: Sales cycles lengthening on AI programs
triggers.quote: which is involved procurement which is naturally going to slow down the decision-making process itself

guidance.quote: Revenue growth will be in the range of 4.5% to 7.5%.
the organic constant currency growth rate is expected to be in the range of 3% to 6%.
non-GAAP diluted EPS will be in the range of $12.60 to $12.90 for the full year.
we expect revenue to be in the range of $1.35 billion to $1.4 billion
we expect to scale this to over $600 million in 2026
all those things give us confidence that we can improve our gross margin between 2025 and 2026.
